working_definition: LC10b is a visual projection neuron of the Drosophila optic lobe, belonging to the LC10A subgroup of lobula columnar neurons. It has its main dendritic arbors in lobula layers 4 to 6 (densest in layer 6), with presynaptic sites concentrated in layer 6 and some in layers 4 and 5A. It is a cholinergic neuron whose axon projects ipsilaterally to the medial zone of the anterior optic tubercle (AOTU).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10A. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 4 to 6, with arbors denser in the latter, and many parallel processes exist between the two layers. Presynaptic sites are mainly observed in layer 6, with some in layers 4 and 5A. It is a cholinergic neuron (Davis et al., 2020).
